title: Opening a locker at the pool
titleZh: 游泳池置物櫃的開啟與換用

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: My wristband opened a locker before my lesson, but it isn’t working now. I remember the locker number. The class has just finished, and my towel and things are still inside.
turns.zh: 我的腕帶在上課前打得開置物櫃，但現在不行了。我記得櫃號。剛下課，我的毛巾和其他物品還在裡面。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I can look up the locker if you still have the band. If the band can’t be read, I’ll ask you to describe what is in the locker before I open it. We don’t issue a new band while the same locker is occupied.
turns.zh: 如果腕帶還在，我可以用它查置物櫃。如果讀不到，我會請你描述櫃內有哪些物品，再幫你打開。有東西還放在同一個櫃子裡時，我們不另發新腕帶。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: I do have it. Can I leave the locker closed and use the same band for my next class this evening?
turns.zh: 腕帶還在。我可以先不開置物櫃，晚上上下一堂課時繼續用同一條腕帶嗎？

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Not that locker. The pool closes between sessions, so please collect everything now. You can get a band for an empty locker when you come back.
turns.zh: 那個櫃子不行。游泳池兩個時段中間會關閉，所以請現在把東西全部拿走。你回來時可以領腕帶，使用一個空的置物櫃。
